{{Quote|Within this group of stars lies the last refuge of the Chiss people should our forces ever be overwhelmed in battle. It is impregnable, impossible for even a determined enemy to quickly or easily penetrate, with war vessels and firepoints scattered throughout. There are also other surprises that nature itself has created for the unwary.|Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano|<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
'''The Redoubt''', also known as the '''Chiss Redoubt''', was a remote [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] that was located in [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]], near the [[Utegetu Nebula/Legends|Utegetu Nebula]], and that contained at least ten habitable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and hundreds of [[Star/Legends|stars]]. It contained the [[Brask Oto Command Station system]], in which was the [[Brask Oto Command Station]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Discovered at some point before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[178 BBY]]<ref name="The Redoubt date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]]. ''Survivor's Quest'' establishes that the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] began studying the Redoubt over two hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of the novel, therefore the Redoubt must have been discovered some time prior to [[178 BBY]].</ref> and claimed by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], the cluster was to be used as a refuge in the event that the Chiss Ascendancy was overrun by any foreign invader. Exploration of the Redoubt by the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] only began in earnest around<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="Outbound Flight date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> The Redoubt contained high radiation levels, and the proximity of stars to each other made navigation difficult. There were only a few safe [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] into The Redoubt, and they were all guarded by [[Firepoint|Chiss fortifications]], which prevented foreign intrusions. A [[Unidentified planetoid (The Redoubt)|planetoid]] in The Redoubt was the resting place of the ill-fated [[Outbound Flight Project]], which crashed there in<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> 27 BBY.<ref name="Outbound Flight date" />
